sources.use: Building history: 1862 stone front/tower, spire removed in 1950s, rebuilt behind retained facade.
Tower side, projecting stair turret, paired louvres, parapet and adjacent modern hall roof.
South flank: red-brick hall with tall rectangular windows; clock on tower side; retained Gothic frontage.
Clear winter frontal composition, gables, traceried windows, clock and doorway.
Close cafe-side elevation, blocked tower window, bell tracery and brick entrance canopy.
Existing locally saved church-gardens satellite and street approach captures, checked visually. Aerial establishes modern roof masses and setback.
Fresh independently isolated browser inspection: cafe side, blocked tower window, bell openings, cafe 1821 sign and timber gabled porch.
Fresh aerial: confirmed main hall hip, corrected eastern annex to three stepped flat roofs and visible rooflight arrays. Heights remain estimates; 3D Earth unavailable.
Fresh south garden approach: modern hall brick side and tall windows, tower clock diamond surround; some facade obscured by trees.

uncertainty: Metric heights and facade depths are calibrated estimates, not measured surveys.
Fine Gothic tracery reconstructed from visible patterns, not traced/photogrammetric sculpture.
No historic spire: model depicts retained square battlemented tower.
Tower middle window is blocked masonry on cafe side; frontal window follows visible stained glazing.
Hidden modern rear openings and interiors omitted.
Reference images remain private local files and are not embedded in model or Git.
Rear street-view query snapped to Cambridge Arcade; no direct rear elevation claimed. Annex heights are calibrated estimates from roof overlaps and cafe-side view.
